name: @weapp-container/runtime-artifact-tools
description: Local verified packaging tools for Weapp Container runtime distributions

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py" -v && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check tools/package-artifacts.mjs && node --check tools/verify-offline.mjs && node --check tools/publish.mjs
